author: hpux
body:
Hello all!

As you know, it is very unfortunate that our loved Administrator, Telitubbles, has decided to retire today. However, I am very pleased to say that the Administration team has decided to promote Straightened as the newest Administrator due to his outstanding work so far! I'd like everyone to give him a warm welcome onto the Administration team! :)
